rationale: Reallocate fp16 export budget toward recurrent-tail attention value paths instead of keeping both tail MLP and attention projections across the whole tail. The best local family is recurrence-driven and earlier close misses suggested recurrent-tail float rescue was still live. This change keeps q/k/v in the recurrent tail, preserves the last block's full projection rescue, and trims older tail projection fp16 retention to stay byte-aware for the final int8+zlib roundtrip metric.
title: Tail Value Rescue Export Reallocation
